187        /**
188         * Useful for building a mod that allows other mods to override some of its data.
189         * 
190         * Merges on spreadsheet level only; rows with matching ids get replaced by non-master rows.
191         * 
192         * If multiple non-master rows have the same id, one will be picked in an undefined manner.
193         * 
194         * 
195         * @param idColumn the column to be used as the key for merging spreadsheets.
196         * @param path the location of the spreadsheet, i.e. "mydata/spreadsheet.csv".
197         * @param masterMod name of the mod that has the master copy of the spreadsheet, which will be used as the base version to add to/modify during the merge. 
198         * @return
199         * @throws IOException
200         * @throws JSONException
201         */
202        JSONArray getMergedSpreadsheetDataForMod(String idColumn, String path, String masterMod) throws IOException, JSONException;
203        
204        JSONObject getMergedJSONForMod(String path, String masterMod) throws IOException, JSONException;
